name: invoice-pdf-template
description: Generate invoice PDFs from HTML and print CSS inside a Worker, store them in R2, and index them in KV.

INVOICES.description: R2 bucket that stores the rendered invoice PDFs. Created automatically on deploy.

INVOICE_INDEX.description: KV namespace that indexes invoice metadata (number, client, total, R2 key) so the list persists. Created automatically on deploy.
